conflict: revision changed or resource already exists
internal: operation failed; no secrets are included in diagnostics
invalid_json_fields: invalid, unknown or oversized JSON fields
single_json_object: exactly one JSON object is required
invalid_host: Host must be a numeric loopback address and port
shutdown_object_required: a shutdown JSON object is required
shutdown_mode_conflict: a different shutdown mode is already selected
invalid_id: path and object ID must agree
invalid_provider: invalid provider configuration; check identity, URLs, protocol, limits and credentials
invalid_model_configuration: invalid model configuration; check identity, settings and candidates
instance_mismatch: write requires the expected instance identity
catalog_refresh_failed: refresh failed; reference was not replaced
skill_unsafe: skill path, permissions or file types are unsupported
skill_changed: skill content or managed link changed; refresh before retrying
skill_limit: skill inventory or content exceeds the documented limits
skill_link_unavailable: symbolic link creation failed; no copy fallback was performed
agent_operation_failed: agent operation failed; inspect local target status and recovery records
agent_model_unavailable: default model is unavailable under the selected model scope; check enabled provider candidates
agent_catalog_invalid: managed model catalog could not be generated; check local templates and model metadata
agent_config_conflict: managed configuration or catalog changed externally; external edits were preserved
agent_config_unsafe: agent configuration cannot be safely edited; check structure, file types and permissions
invalid_model_policy: model and explicit single, all-mapped or all-compatible model_scope required
plan_required: apply requires a reviewed plan fingerprint
tiered_price: context-tiered price cannot be flattened; use model-catalog model/estimate or model settings reference
provider_revision_required: saved provider ID and revision are required
recovery_timeout: upstream timed out before encrypted context recovery
request_too_large: request exceeds the %d MiB gateway limit or cannot be read
request_object_required: a JSON request object is required
model_id_required: a public model ID is required
binding_model_denied: model is outside the binding route scope
previous_response_unsupported: previous_response_id is not supported; submit full input history
conversation_unsupported: server-side conversations are not supported; submit full input history
streaming_unsupported: public model does not advertise streaming
tools_unsupported: public model does not advertise tools
unsupported_tool: only Agent-executed function/custom tools, their namespaces and client tool_search are supported
no_available_candidate: no enabled, supported and available candidate succeeded
unsupported_conversion: unsupported field or content for protocol conversion
proxy_unavailable: configured proxy is unavailable; direct fallback is disabled
upstream_timeout: upstream timed out; execution may be unknown
upstream_transport: upstream transport failed; request was not replayed
unexpected_html: upstream returned an HTML page instead of an API response; check the API base URL (usually ending in /v1)
upstream_missing_usage: upstream omitted usage required by Messages
